title: Private rooms get the Quick Play loop
summary: Host/Join private rooms now have ready-up, a map vote, rematch and spectating while waiting, reusing the Quick Play panel.
details: Lobby: ready ticks, ping bars, HOST and CPU tags. The host gets Start, Mode and CPUs; guests get Ready. The room starts 10 s after every guest is ready.
Vote: cards from the host's mode with the room's own track first, plus Random. 12 s, ends early when everyone has voted; the host's Skip picks the host's card.

Podium is the host's own table (no server checks, no match records). Late joiners get a Next round banner and a follow camera, then take a seat at the next vote. Older builds keep today's flow. PR #671, part of #631.

Verification: protocol and server unit tests; new browser gate tools/test_engine_private_loop.mjs. The PR body does not record the browser run result. Host-only evidence: browser tests on host Chromium against a local game server. Nothing was checked on physical phones.
limitation: The host drives each round and private rounds are not checked, so they add nothing to stats or the league.
